records.name: imagegen-01-early-process
records.prompt:
Create ONE high fidelity structural game UI design concept, target 1440x900 landscape. This is NOT implemented UI. Use attached actual project screenshot as context, actual hangar and formal ship/cannon asset references for visual identity. No outside assets. Keep screenshot's GLOBAL HEADER at x0..808 y0..85 and RIGHT BATTLE CONTEXT x808..1440 unchanged in composition, no redesign of those regions. Redesign ONLY module x0..808 y85..900. Warm ivory, dark teal blue, restrained amber, physical painted hangar and console materials, excellent Chinese type legibility.

ONE proposed organization named 逐槽工作台. Not a compact slot index + separate shared detail panel. Left x0..302 is genuine ship hangar stage with formal frigate, visible whole silhouette, no armour as fake hull parts. Right x310..795 is ONE continuous physical ivory workstation running vertically. Workstation top y110 shows 当前装备 and small 全部升级 entry. It contains per-slot self-contained work rows, each 80px high with 16px Chinese text. Row first line has slot label, existing equipment icon/name with downward chevron (this IS the direct-change dropdown), and paid Lv. Row second line shows current charged-base main value → upgraded value, current equipment upgrade cost, plus two separate tactile buttons ×1 and 购买1级 aligned in that same row. There is no shared distant action panel. Clicking another slot stays within adjacent rows and its own local benefits and purchase. No candidates visible when closed. No constant comparison half, no bottom installation bar, no confirm, no inventory, no recent results/history. Show early stage ONLY 2 active slots: group 武器 · 1, row 武器1 脉冲炮⌄ Lv.1 当前攻击力350→420, 升级费 [amber iron ingot]铁65, ×1, 购买1级 disabled with 资源不足 (wallet0). group 防御 · 1, row 防御1 装甲⌄ Lv.1 容量1000→1200, upgrade iron65, ×1, disabled购买1级. Numbers are illustrative concept content, do not invent precision formula. Workstation rows stay same size even early game, remaining space is quiet hangar/workstation surface without placeholder future slots or tutorial prose. Ship hangs unobscured to LEFT of all rows, never vertically between selecting equipment and its upgrades. No need to select row before buying; identity, outcome, fee and two buttons stay grouped. Keep broad ambient physical stage to left, professional purposeful composition, no overlapping rows, no giant card icon or unexplained bars. Render Chinese labels accurately. Tiny module-only label 结构候选 · 未实施 near title.
